_comment: Worker <-> server contract. Read by server/ai-board/store.js and ai-board/worker.py; change here only.

limits._why: All AI Board caps in one place (feature-folders ticket 02). Per-run caps scale with the plan's subtask count n: base + per_subtask * n, clamped to max. Numbers are starting points; retune from the stratified eval (ticket 12).

units._why: GPU-s per run; a feature draft of 3-10 subtasks needs ~450-1600

wall_clock_s._why: each subtask may retry up to 4 times at 14B speed

model_calls._why: gate 1/2.5 calls + up to 4 attempts x (implement, repair) per subtask

pending_roots_per_user._why: one person cannot fill the school's queue

open_folders_per_user._why: feature folders not yet archived; keeps branches and context bounded

folder_archive_days._why: a folder with no activity this long is archived: its cycle closes, history and brief stay

context._why: Feature-folder context tiers (ticket 06), chars. L1 brief + L3 recent requests are computed from the DB at read time; L2 owned-file outlines come from git. Full history never enters a prompt.

gpu_s_per_user_day._why: rolling 24h; over it the request waits, a running run is never cut

gpu_s_per_worker_hour._why: must exceed one max run (2400) so big tasks are not starved

memory._why: Worker-local files under ai-board/memory/ (gitignored). Everything there is a rebuildable cache except lessons; the worker prunes at start. Folder memory lives in the DB, not here. With a second worker, lessons move to a server table.

self_improve._why: Nightly self-improvement loop (.scratch/ai-board-self-improve spec). Off until an admin turns it on; never starts below min_labelled_tasks. Labelled eval tasks split by time: oldest learning_split to learn from, the rest to test on.
